test_objective: Check that you can query the geometry property from an entity

test_cases.name: 018_01_03 Query the geometry property from an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query the geometry property from an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: geoproperty set to 'location'
}
